input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves User, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including formatted message. The platform provides capabilities for basic authentication success handler, bearer token reactive authentication manager, j w t token. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage formatted message records, so that I can track and organize formatted message data effectively.
As a User, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
